definition: סָדִין noun [masculine] linen wrapper (perhaps foreign word; compare Assyrian sudinnu Dl HWB 490, a garment ; Late Hebrew סָדִין , ᵑ7 סְדִינָא , Syriac , (rare) Mark 15:46 > compare Arabic , veil, saddle-cover (see Lane 1335 ), or , Greek [and ᵐ5 ] σινδών , compare Frä 48 Lewy Fremdw. 85 ); — absolute ׳ ס Prov 31:24 plural סְדִינִים Judg 14:12 ; Judg 14:13 ; — wrapper or rectangular piece of fine linen , worn as outer, or (at night) as sole garment (compare GFM Judg 14, 12 ), + חֲלִפֹּת בְּגָדִים Judg 14:12 ; Judg 14:13 , in list of women's finery Isa 3:23 , made and sold by the capable woman Prov 31:24 .
